info.summary: Open, edit and save .figcraft design files right in Nextcloud
Ouvrez, modifiez et enregistrez des maquettes .figcraft directement dans Nextcloud
info.description:
Edit `.figcraft` design files in your browser without leaving Nextcloud. Files stay in Nextcloud: sharing, versions and access rights work as for any other file.
Based on FigCraft (MIT / Apache-2.0), https://github.com/storytold/figcraft. This app is not made or endorsed by the FigCraft or ArtCraft teams.
